prompt: An atmospheric conceptual illustration in a moody watercolor and dark ink wash style. In the center, a small, completely isolated, stark-white featureless humanoid silhouette stands alone. Surrounding them in a dense, imposing circle is a massive crowd of towering, shadowy, faceless figures painted in dark muted teals and charcoal grays. Luminous, pale yellow-green organic energy veins flow across the bodies of the dark figures, interconnecting them like a glowing, shared nervous system or ethereal roots. The central white figure remains entirely blank and disconnected from this glowing network. High contrast between the dark crowd and the glowing elements, heavy paper texture, eerie lighting, claustrophobic, haunting and uncanny mood, visual metaphor for isolation.
visual_logic: A small, simple central figure is surrounded by larger, more densely connected figures that appear more socially embedded, visually expressing that your friends are, on average, more connected than you are.
